lore_anchors.definition: A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will, intent, and Dao-heart. It is more intangible than elemental ki or divine power, but masters can use it to empower techniques like archery to terrifying degrees.
A Daoist concept where total, unwavering commitment to a single discipline unlocks profound power and understanding. It is considered more important than raw talent for achieving mastery.

A peerless divine ability ranked among the top ten since Pangu created the world. Created by the ancient god Houyi, it is the ultimate archery art of the Three Realms, capable of slaying True Gods, but with immense heartforce and equipment demands.

Another supreme divine ability or technique stored in the Three Realms Palace, which Ji Ning prepares to study next. Its name evokes the primordial god Zhulong (Candle Dragon), a mythic being whose breath created the seasons.
